title: Signature Behavior-Derived Scaffolding
description: A Signature original: scaffolding derives from observed runtime behavior, generating tests that capture what the code actually does - then humans assert what it should do. Behavior is the starting point. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Constraint-Respecting Fixtures
description: A Signature original: generated fixtures respect cross-field constraints - end after start, totals match lines - so tests exercise valid states. Invalid fixtures are never generated. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Contract-Verified Mocks
description: A Signature original: mocks are verified against the real dependency's contract tests, so mock drift - where the mock lies about reality - is caught automatically. Mocks stay honest. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Regression-Capturing Property Tests

title: Signature Coverage-Guided Corpus Evolution
description: A Signature original: the corpus evolves automatically, keeping only inputs that expand coverage and retiring redundant ones. The corpus stays lean and potent. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Mutation-Tested Coverage

title: Signature Counterexample-Checked Inference
